verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents event-driven triggers that draft replies when emails arrive, add team comments, organize threads into todos and connect to 3,000+ apps (shortwave-docs-1). Its custom AI filters automatically label, star and archive mail using plain-English scripts (shortwave-docs-15). The Tasklet integration acts on emails automatically (shortwave-docs-36). Together these cover the core of autonomous background automation, but the evidence is only short changelog and marketing lines. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of trigger configuration, limits and run history; independent or hands-on corroboration that the automations run reliably unattended.
